title: 1981 AHSME Problem 7
statement: How many of the first one hundred positive integers are divisible by all of the numbers \(2,\) \(3,\) \(4,\) \(5?\)

solutions.text:
The least common multiple is \(\operatorname{lcm}(2,3,4,5)=60.\) Among the positive integers through \(100,\) only \(60\) is a multiple of \(60.\) Thus the count is \(1.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Find the least common multiple of \(2,\) \(3,\) \(4,\) and \(5\)
Count the multiples of that least common multiple through \(100\)
